verdict.rationale: Green and Spiegel is an immigration law firm offering legal services such as visa applications, consultations and compliance. It is not a software product, so user-defined event-triggered automation rules are a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any such capability; the probes found no llms.txt and no API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
